## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.Valve(
    value="open",
    label="Valve (open, 60 %)",
    position=60,
    tag="XV-101",
    auto=False,
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `commands` | array of string | `["open","close"]` | host | Commands offered on the faceplate (a constant of each widget). |
| `value` | `"open"`, `"closed"`, `"transit"`, `"fault"` | `"closed"` | host | Valve state (feedback from the process). |
| `position` | number or null | `null` | host | Opening in % for a control valve (feedback); null: on/off valve. A control valve faceplate also takes a position demand in manual mode (with simulate, applied to position and value). |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal"`, `"vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | host |  |
